subject.title: improve(agents): normalized web_search output contract with boundary-owned wrapping

question: Should `web_search` permanently narrow all model-facing provider outputs to the proposed four-branch contract, including removal of provider-specific extras and structured error-code distinctions?
rationale: The PR explicitly makes intentional compatibility tradeoffs on a shared agent-tool contract; code review alone cannot choose which existing provider data is part of the durable model-facing product contract.

options.title: Adopt the closed contract
options.body: Accept the normalized four-branch output as the canonical public model-facing shape after complete provider and caller compatibility review.

options.body: Keep the boundary normalization but retain specifically justified provider fields or diagnostics through a documented compatible shape.

options.title: Pause for contract design
options.body: Defer the PR until maintainers define the durable `web_search` output and external-provider compatibility policy.
